title: painting.json
description: Everything true of ONE painting and nothing true of any other. Lives in jobs/<name>/. The kit's procedure and the tools in tools/ are both instance-free; this file is where the instance goes. If you find yourself wanting to hardcode a number in a tool, it belongs here.

title.description: the work, as it should be credited

provenance.description: where the scan came from; verify before shipping

shot.description: the working frame cut out of the master

crop.description: crop.json written by locate-crop — the master<->shot transform

space.description: what was MEASURED about this painting's depth, not what was assumed

depthRowVariance.description: fraction of estimate-depth variance explained by image row alone. High (~0.55) means a ramp: landscape depth must be authored

hasStationPoint.description: true only if measured. If true, photographic depth and projection mapping are available and better than planes

planes.description: dir from segment-points, planned at SHOT scale

figures.description: things that move as a body

robed.description: true = legs are hidden, so a walk is hem swing + bob + travel and nothing is invented

limbs.description: cut-stroke dir; required when robed is false

reliefDepth.description: estimate-depth map of this figure at MASTER resolution. Trust it on a body, never on thin limbs

stance.description: fraction of the cycle a foot is planted

shots.description: camera moves. Travel equal to pan is walking in place

over.description: mask dir laid back on top: the overlay cel, so a puppet passes behind painted foreground

pathEvidence.description: where the travel numbers came from IN THE PAINTING. A path read off the picture, not invented

regions.description: water and foliage, animated by displacing the painter's own ink

mode.description: lift needs inpaintable ground behind; warp when it is textured
